# Ultha (ultha.co)

> Ultha Moktan does customer research for founder-led B2B AI startups. AI research gives everyone the same answers; she talks to a startup's customers (won, stalled and lost) and finds the patterns, so founders get a clear direction for sales and marketing: what to focus on, who to target and what to say.

About: Former product manager and co-founder of a marketing agency that worked with 40+ brands. Customer research she ran led to +34% and +17% feature adoption. Based in Santa Barbara, CA. Contact: ultha@ultha.co.

## Services and prices
- Why They Buy sprint, $9,500, 4 weeks (first 3 clients: $5,500 instead of $9,500, for a January start with kickoff by Dec 18 and calls Jan 5-23; 50% at signing, 50% after the workshop, and the client can stop after the first 5 calls and owe only the first half; in return a named case study and quote the client approves, 2 intros and 1 reference call): 10-15 interviews with won, stalled and lost buyers; findings report and one-page summary; positioning and messaging fix sheet; quote bank; 1-hour decision workshop; check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days. The founder makes warm intros; Ultha handles scheduling, interviews and analysis.
- Won, Lost, Left, $3,000/month (first clients: $2,500/month for the first 3 months): 4 interviews a month with customers who bought, stalled or left, a monthly working session, and updated direction on ICP, priorities and messaging. 3-month minimum.
- Something custom (for example a homepage rewrite or a different mix of calls): scoped on request. https://ultha.co/pricing#custom
- Free homepage review: send a homepage, get a short written review, either private (sent only to the founder) or public on her socials with credit. https://ultha.co/#review
- Book a 20-minute call: https://cal.com/ultha

## Who it's for
Founder-led B2B software startups, mostly AI, with real customers (about 25 to 30 people who decided in the last six months, at least 10 of them paying) and nobody owning customer research yet. Common problems: "everyone said yes and nobody bought", "we sound like every other AI tool", lost deals that give polite excuses, churned customers who don't reply.

## Methods
Customer interviews, win-loss interviews, churn interviews, jobs-to-be-done (switch) questions, voice-of-customer research, building an ideal customer profile (ICP) from best customers. Calls are confidential; quotes are anonymized unless a customer agrees.

- [Sample review: why customers buy Attio](https://ultha.co/sample-review): what Attio's homepage says vs. what public reviews say, where they don't match, and what to test. Built from public reviews, not client work.
- [Q1 planning](https://ultha.co/q1): go into Q1 knowing why customers buy. First 3 clients, starting in January.
